description:
Turn your daily steps into a growing creature collection.

Walk to hatch eggs, evolve Nanobeasts, and discover new companions. Set a daily step goal, build streaks, collect badges, and explore your Field Dex.

YOUR MOVEMENT, AT A GLANCE
Track steps and activity with Apple Health. Review your progress, history, and milestones on iPhone.

TAKE YOUR COMPANION ON A WALK
The Apple Watch app puts your current creature or egg beside your step progress. See your weekly steps, hourly activity, distance, active energy, and exercise time. Swipe to choose a workout and follow live stats as you move.

REMEMBER THE JOURNEY
Record outdoor walks and other supported workouts. Review your workout time, steps, distance, pace, and active energy on iPhone. With location and route recording enabled, watch your route clear the fog and share a replay video with your workout stats.

MAKE IT YOURS
Choose your daily goal and reminders, and find privacy information and purchase options in Settings.

Try Nanobeasts through its built-in free onboarding experience. Continue with a Nanobeasts Pro monthly subscription or lifetime access for a single payment. Monthly renews automatically until cancelled; lifetime has no recurring charges. Neither plan includes an additional free trial. Restore Purchases is available in the app.

Privacy Policy: https://nanobeasts.app/privacy
Terms of Use: https://nanobeasts.app/terms
review_notes:
Nanobeasts turns walking into a creature-collection journey. No email, account, or sign-in is required. The name field is optional and comes after the user's walking goals and barriers.

Nanobeasts offers built-in free onboarding progression before the Pro paywall. The paywall offers $4.99/month (nanobeasts_native_premium_monthly) or $29.99 lifetime access in the US; closing it presents a small $19.99 lifetime win-back popup. Monthly is auto-renewing with no trial. Both are NON_CONSUMABLE one-time purchases granting the same permanent Premium entitlement, with no StoreKit trial or recurring billing. StoreKit supplies localized prices. Product IDs are nanobeasts_native_premium_lifetime and nanobeasts_native_premium_lifetime_winback. Restore Purchases is available on the paywall and saved-journey screen. Existing yearly purchases remain supported for access and restoration.

Declining the win-back popup returns to the saved journey without unlocking paid access. Onboarding answers and workout history remain saved locally. An inactive returning customer can review monthly or lifetime options, restore purchases, or manage an existing legacy subscription.

Notifications are optional. The onboarding permission explanation expressly includes up to five setup reminders, two days apart, for users who leave before purchasing. These use local notifications, without a remote push service or name upload. They stop after the fifth message, purchase activation, onboarding completion, or opt-out. Users can opt out during onboarding, on the paywall, or in Settings. No discount is promised in reminder copy.

Onboarding step charts show an illustrative path from an estimated baseline to a suggested, editable goal; they are not measured or guaranteed results.

After onboarding, grant optional Apple Health access for supported background activity. The workout button opens the iPhone workout hub, with a first-use tour of the map, activity picker, goals, start control, and History. The tour can be skipped and reopened using the question-mark button. It does not interrupt an active/resumed workout. With location enabled, outdoor workouts can record a route and permanently clear explored map areas. Completed workouts with routes offer replay and video sharing with a creature/egg marker and stats.

The Apple Watch companion receives the iPhone's subscription access state, current creature/egg, step goal, and accent. Purchase monthly or lifetime access, or restore Premium on iPhone and open both apps to synchronize. An in-progress workout remains available to finish/save if access expires; new workouts require active access. Please use physical devices and actual movement to evaluate HealthKit, GPS, and paired connectivity; missing Health samples are not fabricated.

The native bundle is com.twosyntaxerrors.nanobeasts.native. The separate, unreleased Expo app record is retained independently.
